scope: Persistent four-worker join comparing the reference nullable VARCHAR row with the Cranelift archive adapter on the same circuit builder. Keys include inline strings, longer UTF-8 and embedded NUL. The paired signed deltas are checked against expected Z-sets.
checkpoint_scope: Bytes of manifest and dependencies after DBSP compaction completes. Total allocated bytes also agree in all pairs.
history: Initial overlay throughput at 2,048 rows was 0.569563 of classic. Root-only native serialization removes transient vectors and writes payloads once. Moving ownership to the fixture scope and the archive resolver removes per-key Arc copies. Timings use the same writer without observation atomics. An uncompacted pair had additional native files. The final paired run records live checkpoint and allocated bytes separately.
